paragraphs.text:
The three of you bound after Bernard. Since he is hobbled, you 
quickly get ahead of him. The ape-men behind are incited by 
your scent of fear and run after you. Despite their size and bulk, 
they move swiftly. You will have to use the terrain against them.
Make a Spot Hidden roll: if you succeed, go to 625; if you fail, go to 628.
